Ha-Mim.
Ukwembulela okuvela koNomusa Onesihawu.
iNcwadi omibiko yayo icacisiwe eyiKurani yesi Arabhu kubantu abanolwazi.
Yethula izindaba ezinhle futhi iyexwayisa; kepha iningi labo liyishaye indiva abafuni ukulalela.
Futhi bathi: “Izinhliziyo zethu zivalekile kulokho osimemela kukho futhi izindlebe zethu azizwa futhi phakathi kwethu nawe kunesithiyo; ngakho-ke yenza [okwenzayo] nathi siyenza”.
Yithi: “Mina ngingumuntu nje ofana nani, kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi okumele nimkhonze uyedwa nje vo, ngakho-ke yibani qotho kuYe futhi nicele kuYe intethelelo. Futhi imbubhiso ikulabo ababhangqayo”.
Labo abangayikhiphi izakati futhi abangakholelwa kwelizayo.
Impela labo abakholwayo nabenza okulungileyo bayothola umvuzo ongenamkhawulo.
Yithi: “Ingabe anikholelwa kuLowo odale umhlaba ezinsukwini ezimbili futhi namqokela izimbangi na? Loyo iNkosi yendalo yonke”.
Wafaka phezu kwawo izikhonkwane [izintaba] futhi wafaka izibusiso kuwo waphinde waba kuwo isondlo sawo ezinsukwini ezine – [ukwazisa] labo ababuzayo, kuyefana [akuguquki].
Wabe esephendukela ezulwini lisaseyintuthu, wathi kuwo nomhlaba: “Wozani [nibe khona] ngokuthanda noma ngenkani”. Athi: “Siza ngokuthanda”.

Wabe eselenza amazulu ayisikhombisa ezinsukwini ezimbili, wembulela kulelo nalelo zulu umyalelo walo. Futhi sahlobisa isibhakabhaka ngezibani nokuthi zibe isivikelo. Lokho ukuhlela kukaSomandla Owaziyo.
Uma bengenandaba, yithi: “Nginixwayiswa ngembubhiso [eshaqa konke] efana nembubhiso yabakwa AdinoTamudi.

Mhla iZithunywa zabo zifika kubo ngaphambi nasemuva kwabo [zilandelana], [zithi]: “Ningakhonzi lutho ngaphandle kuka Allah”. Bathi: “Ukube u Allah ubethanda ngabe uthumele izingelosi; impela thina asikholelwa kulokho ezithunywe nakho”.

Mayelana no Adi, bona baziqhayisa ezweni ngokungemthetho futhi bathi: “Ubani onamandla ukudlula thina na?” Ingabe ababoni yini ukuthi u Allah lona obadalile nguYena onamandla ukudlula bona; futhi babephika imibiko yeThu.
Sathumela kubo umoya oyisivunguvungu ezinsukwini ezimbi, ukuze sibazwise isijeziso esihlazanayo empilweni yasemhlabeni; futhi isijeziso sakwelizayo sihlazisana kakhulu, futhi abayikusizwa.
Mayelana noTamudi, sabahola kepha bona bathanda ubumpumputhe kunokuholeka base-ke behlaselwa imbubhiso yesijeziso esihlazanayo ngenxa yalokho ababekwenza.
Futhi sabahlenga laba ababekholwa futhi ababethobela u Allah.
Futhi ngosuku lapho izitha zika Allah ziyobuthaniswa emlilweni futhi bayoqhutshwa.
Kuyothi uma sebefike kuwo, izindlebe zabo namehlo abo nezikhumba zabo ziyofakaza ngabo ngalokho ababekwenza.
Bayothi kuzikhumba zabo: “Kungani nifakaze ngathi na?”. Ziyothi: “U Allah lona owenze yonke ikhulume, nguYena osenze sakhuluma”. NguYe owanidala kwasekuqaleni futhi nizobuyela kuYe”.
Futhi beningafihli [izimpambuko] ngoba nakhu izindlebe zenu namehlo enu nezikhumba zenu zizofakaza ngani; kodwa kungoba benicabanga ukuthi u Allah akakwazi okuningi kwenikwenzayo.
Yilokho ebenikucabanga ngeNkosi yenu; unitshingile [emlilweni] naba ngabalahlekelwe.
Noma bengabekezela umlilo uyolokhu uyindawo yabo futhi uma becela elinye ithuba, abasoze banikwa elinye ithuba.

Sabaqokela abalingani ababenzela kuhle lokhu okuphambi kwabo [impilo yasemhlabeni] nokusemuva kwabo [kwelizayo lapho besuka khona], futhi bafanelwa isinqumo esehlela izizwe ezibandulelayo zamajini nabantu; impela balahlekelwa.
Futhi laba abangakholwa bathi: “Ningayilaleli leKurani futhi nibange umsindo ukuze ninqobe”.
Impela sizobazwisa laba abangakholwa isijeziso esibuhlungu futhi sizobanika umvuzo balokhu okubi ababekwenza.
Lowo umvuzo wezitha zika Allah, umlilo; uyoba indawo yabo yaphakade; kuwumvuzo wokuphika kwabo imibiko yeThu.
Futhi laba abangakholwa bayothi: “Nkosi yethu, sitshengise laba abasidukisile kumajini nabantu ukuze sizobafaka phansi kwezinyawo zethu ukuze badicileleke phansi”.
Impela labo abathi: “iNkosi ngu Allah”, bese bezimisela babeqotho, izingelosi ziyokwehlela kubo zithi: “Ningesabi ningakhathazeki, futhi nithakasele iJana lena enithenjiswe yona”.
Thina singabangani benu empilweni yasemhlabeni nakwelizayo; futhi niyothola kuyo noma yini eyihalelayo futhi niyothola kuyo noma yini enikufunayo.
Isondlo esivela kuMthetheleli Onesihawu.
Futhi ngubani ongcono ngenkulumo kunalowo omemela ku Allah futhi owenza okulungileyo bese ethi: “ngiyiMusilimu”.
Futhi okuhle nokubi akufani. Phindisela ngalokho okungcono. Uyobona lowo okunobutha phakathi kwakhe nawe, esengathi umngani omkhulu.
Kutholwa yilabo ababekezelayo futhi kutholwa yilabo abanesabelo esikhulu.
Uma ufikelwa isilingo esivela kuShayitani, zivikele ngo Allah; impela Yena ungoZwayo Owaziyo.
Futhi kwezinye izibonakaliso zaKhe, ubusuku nemini nelanga nenyanga; musanike ukukhothamela ilanga noma inyanga kepha khothamelani u Allah lona okudalile uma ngempela nikhonza Yena kuphela.
Uma beziqhayisa; labo-ke abaseNkosini yakho bayidumisa ubusuku nemini futhi abakhathali.
Futhi kwezinye zezibonakaliso zaKhe, ukuthi ubone umhlaba ufile, kuthi lapho sesithele amanzi kuwo, uqhakaze ukhule. Impela lowo owuvuselele uyovusa abafileyo; impela Yena akehlulwa yilutho.

Impela labo abaphambukayo emibikweni yeThu abafihlekile kithi. Ingabe lowo otshingelwa emlilweni ungcono yini kunalowo oyofika ephephile ngoSuku lokwahlulela na?; yenzani enikuthandayo, impela Yena Uyakubona lokho enikwenzayo.
Impela labo abangakholwa iSikhumbuzo [iKurani] lapho ifika kubo [bayojezisa]. Impela iyiNcwadi enamandla.
Akukho mbhedo ongafika kuyo ngaphambili noma ngemuva kwayo; yembulelwe Okhaliphile Odunyiswayo.
Akukho okushiwo kuwe okungashiwongo kuZithunywa ezikwandulelayo; impela iNkosi yakho inentethelelo futhi inesijeziso esibuhlungu.

Ukube sayenza kwaba iKurani ngolunye ulwimi, bebezothi: “Uma nje imibiko yayo ingacaciswa, olunye ulwimi nesi Arabhu [kanjani]?”. Yithi: “Ingumholi kulabo abakholwayo nekhambi”. Futhi laba abangakholwa, ezindlebenizabo kunehonqo futhi uma kufika kuyo bayizimpumputhe. Yibo labo abayobizwa endaweni esekudeni.

Impela sanika uMusa iNcwadi kepha kwaphikiswana ngayo. Ukube bekungekona ukuthi izwi elivela ku Allah seliphumile [lokunika isikhathi], ngabe sekuhlulelwe phakathi kwabo. Kepha bona banokungabaza abanasiqiniseko ngakho.
Lowo owenza okulungileyo uzisiza yena futhi lowo owenza okubi uzilaya yena; futhi iNkosi yakhe ayisoze yenza okungebulungiswa kusigqila.

Ulwazi lweSikhathi lubuyiselwa kuYe. Futhi lezo zithelo eziphuma emakhasini azo, nalokho okukhulelwa owesifazane nalokho akuzalayo kwenzeka ngoLwazi lwaKhe. Futhi ngokusu lapho eyobamemeza athi: “Baphi abalingani baMi na?”. Bayothi: “Sikutshelile ukuthi akekho kithi ofakazela [lokho]”.
Kwabadukela lokho ababekukhonza phambilini futhi baqinisekiseka ukuthi angeke bakwazi ukubaleka.
Umuntu akadinwa ukukhulekela okuhle, kepha uma ehlelwa okubi, uvele aphelelwe nya ithemba.

Uma sizwisa umuntu umusa ovela kithi emuva kokwehlelwa ubunzima, uvele athi: “Lokhu okwami futhi angicabangi ukuthi iSikhathi [sokwaHlulelwa] siyofika, futhi uma ngibuyela eNkosini yami, impela ngiyothola okuhle”. Sizokwazisa labo abangakholwa ngalokho ababekwenza futhi sizobazwisa isijeziso esibuhlungu.
Futhi uma senzela umuntu umusa uyafulathela ashaye indiva, kepha uma ehlelwa okubi wenza umkhuleko omude.
Yithi: “Ake ningitshele, uma ivela ku Allah kepha nina nangayikholwa; ngubani oduke ukundlula lowo ophambukele kude le?”
Sizobabonisa izibonakaliso zeThu kwimiphelamehlo nakubo uqobo kuze kubacacele ukuthi iyiqiniso. Ingabe akwanele yini ukuthi iNkosi iyibona yonke into na?
Bheka! Impela banokungabaza ngokuhlangana neNkosi yabo. Bheka! Impela yona yengamele yonke into.
